Maya Li: Heads up — prod deploys started failing around 09:40. deploy-bot getting 403 when impersonating ci-runner@redwood-sa. Anyone made changes to token TTLs?
Jason Patel: Yep I see it too. Logs show `Token exchange failed: impersonation window expired`. I can repro on a local runner. @Maya any recent pipeline changes?
Ashley R.: Not from app-side. Platform tightened service-account short-lived token TTL last week. Could be related. Where are tokens being cached — Vault or runner local cache?
Kevin Zhou: Quick look at audit logs: `protoPayload.status.message="Token exchange failed: audience mismatch or window expired"` — often happens when parallel jobs reuse a token that's just about to expire.
Maya Li: Repro steps I used: 1) start pipeline with 8 parallel jobs, 2) each job runs `gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=redwood-deploy`, 3) some jobs succeed, a few hit `ERROR 403: Permission denied: Token expired (exp < now)`.
deploy-bot: deploy start for service-x (build 2026-03-17T09:39Z) :gear:
Jason Patel: Hypothesis: runner image caches identity tokens in /tmp/ci-tokens and uses them across parallel jobs. With tightened TTL + small clock skew between issuer and runner, effective window becomes tiny. Also saw key rotation events in issuer around same time.
Ashley R.: Short-term mitigation: force token refresh at job start and disable reuse for parallel steps. Patch suggestion: set `CI_RUNNER_REFRESH_ON_START=true` and `TOKEN_CACHE_TTL=2s` in runner config. That fixed my local repro.
Kevin Zhou: For GCP Workload Identity we can also request a shorter explicit lifetime when impersonating: `--min-lifetime` / `--include-email` options? Need to confirm exact flag. Long-term we should either loosen the issuer TTL slightly or make runner token caching robust to near-expiry (refresh threshold = 50% TTL).
Maya Li: I'll push a hotfix to runner image (disable cache by default for parallel pipelines) and open an ops ticket to review issuer TTL vs rotation cadence. Can someone drop the exact audit links and the runner config diff into the ticket? :thumbsup:
Jason Patel: Dropping config diff and pipeline logs into the ticket now. Also adding a short repro script: ```
# repro script
for i in {1..8}; do 
  (gcloud auth print-identity-token --audiences=redwood-deploy | xargs -I{} curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer {}" https://internal-deploy/api/health) &
done
wait
```
Ashley R.: Nice. I'll follow-up with a small postmortem template after we confirm ops' TTL decision. For now, workaround deployed and rolling back failing pipelines. :white_check_mark:
